body:
Review fix for the findings at fabf04253. New head: ed4612b52 (it also merges origin/main). The PR stays a draft. The new head needs a fresh review.

The findings are one class: the life of the JSON file. One rule now closes the class (`direct::cargo`, `direct::JsonFile`):

1. The file leaked on an early return and on a hard kill. A guard (`JsonFile`, its `Drop`) now removes the file on each exit: green, red, a failed start, an early return. The file is next to the step log (`<step log>.json`), in the log directory of the run. Only a hard kill of xtask can leave it, and then it stays in that run directory.
   - Pinned by `watchdog_tests::a_recording_build_ends_when_cargo_exits_not_when_its_descendants_do` (removed after a green build).
   - Pinned by `watchdog_tests::the_json_file_is_removed_after_a_failed_build_and_a_failed_start` (removed after a red build and after a cargo that cannot start).
2. `File::create` at a predictable name in the shared temp directory. The file is now opened with `create_new(true)` in the run's own log directory. An entry at the name is an error. The gate does not follow it, write it or remove it.
   - Pinned by `watchdog_tests::an_entry_at_the_json_name_is_not_followed`.
3. A create or read error stopped the gate through `exec.rs:274`. An I/O error of the file (create, clone, read) is now `Some(Err(why))`. The build runs with its JSON dropped. `exec.rs` prints "no test executable of <crate> recorded (<why>); its steps start cargo".
   - Pinned by `watchdog_tests::an_io_error_of_the_json_file_records_nothing_and_the_build_still_runs`.
4. The test did not pin the removal. Items 1 and 2 above pin it now.

Gate on ed4612b52 (CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6, -j 6):
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask`: 333 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

The decision record `docs/decisions/3675-prebuild-json-file.md` has the rule.

Ready to merge. Class: SAME. The merge relies on the delta review at `ed4612b52`, which built the trial merge with the current main (333 xtask tests, clippy clean). Main has changed no file in `xtask/` since then, and `git merge-tree` is clean.
